scope: atomic checkpoint and exact-resume local integration; not CUDA readiness or execution authorization
roundtrip_and_next_update: exact CPU tensors, optimizer, scheduler, Torch/Python/NumPy RNG and next training window
fixture: real model classes, production Q/KV width and T1024, one layer/FFN128/vocab64/CPU FP32/B1 accumulation2
publication: exclusive per-run writer lock; unique retained partial directory; fsync files/directories; complete marker before same-filesystem directory rename
external_trust_anchor: caller must provide expected checkpoint-manifest SHA and complete independently retained run identity
resume: validate all file hashes and state identities before restore; weights_only tensor load; restore RNG last
pruning: only validated same-run ordinary step directories after new checkpoint publication; append-only deletion ledger
partial_failure: preserve failed partials; no overwrite, stale-lock removal, implicit retry or source-change exception
